content: Standard URL-shortener system design separates the write-heavy/low-volume link-management API from the read-heavy/high-volume redirect path (read:write ratio commonly cited ~100:1). Redirect path: load balancer -> redirect service -> cache lookup (Redis, read-through) -> DB fallback on miss -> populate cache -> HTTP redirect. Analytics/click tracking is decoupled from the redirect's hot path via async event emission (fire-and-forget write / queue) so click logging never blocks or slows the redirect response.
